digest.component_or_area: plan-review T10 overlay rubric and evaluation spec
propositions: T10 rubric must partition routine durable-infrastructure checks from transient de-risk experiments by adding an exact scope clause near the top that excludes throwaway experiments while retaining all four existing MAJOR safety classes (destructive apply, wildcard-admin access, plaintext secret, untrusted-network endpoint auth).

T10 rubric must include an exact co-located safety qualifier immediately after the scope clause that preserves in-scope coverage of the four MAJOR safety classes for transient infrastructure that violates them.
T10 rubric must remain independent without naming T15 or assigning scope to other overlays.

A new packaged eval spec plan-review-T10.eval.yaml must contain ten balanced dataset cases: five pass cases (throwaway loopback probe with teardown, fully specified durable infrastructure, private-network transient probe with scoped IAM, transient probe using secret manager, disposable sandbox with safe teardown) and five finding cases (under-specified durable lifecycle, destructive transient apply on shared data, transient wildcard-admin, transient plaintext secret, untrusted-network transient service with unspecified auth).

Offline text-contract tests must lock the exact scope clause, exact co-located safety qualifier, and rubric independence; the live criterion eval must prove agentic discrimination across the ten balanced cases with recall=1.0, false_accept=0.0, and stability=1.0.

Test registration, prompt rendering through rebar explain, and generated criteria guide must all surface the exact durable-infrastructure scope clause and the exact four-MAJOR-class safety qualifier without modification.
